rule: Spin-offs in the sample. Prices are not adjusted for a distribution: the ex-date's bar drops by the value spun off, and for a while the trailing (T) or fiscal-year (F) EPS still holds the unit the price no longer does, so the P/E reads cheap. For an event marked confirmed (from checks.py's spins table: the /full move against SPY on the ex-date and the distribution the dividend-adjusted series implies): a position held at the last close before the ex-date is sold at that close, and a plan still waiting for its first buy there is cancelled (sim, reason 'spin'); no plan starts on that close; no new T plan for 365 days after the ex-date, no new F plan until the end of that fiscal year (panel.build). Dates are from memory until confirmed; an unconfirmed event changes nothing.
